title: Content Preview: See Your Changes Before You Publish | Orchard Core
description:
Editing content in a form does not show the page it produces.

The Content Preview feature opens a separate window that follows the editor while you type, and the Preview Draft button in the content items list opens the saved draft. Neither one saves or publishes anything.

In this video:
• Two ways to preview: Preview and Preview Draft
• Enable Content Preview in Tools, Features
• Preview while you edit, in a separate window
• Preview a saved draft from the content items list
• Permissions, limits, and the Preview part
